in_sanskrit.name: Avvesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Avvesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Avvesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Av-Vesha', meaning 'God's Grace'. This name is given to a child born under the divine blessings of the gods, symbolizing their presence and protection throughout the child's life.
